query.normalizedText:
SELECT id, customer_id, total_cents, created_at
FROM orders
WHERE status = $1
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT $2

findings.title: Sequential scan with an unindexed filter
findings.evidence: Seq Scan on orders filters status (est. 23529 of ~200000 rows, total cost 2941.59).

findings.title: Sort feeding a Limit (top-N could use an ordered index)
findings.evidence: Top-N sorts orders by created_at (sort node cost 4708.87); an index in that order avoids the sort.

candidate.rationale: Equality on status then order by created_at

validation.label: Planner-validated (HypoPG estimate): total cost 5921 → 709 (−88.0%). Estimate from the planner, not a runtime measurement.

valueRange.label: Across 3 sampled values of orders.status (HypoPG planner estimates): −87.3% for a common value of orders.status (12.6% of rows), up to −89.9% (generic plan: −88.0%, which is what the ranking uses).

footprint.label: Estimated index size 8.0 MB (HypoPG estimate), ≈70% of the table's 11.5 MB — every write to the indexed columns also maintains it.
